Thanks again for all your awesome feedback, suggestions, and bug reports! 🙌

notes.title: Quick Update April 21 (PF61)
notes.notes:
Thanks so much for all the feedback, suggestions, and bug reports—we’ve implemented most of them! 🙌

notes.title: Quick Update for Meteor Showers and Old Saves (PF60)
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your continued feedback, suggestions, and bug reports—we’ve implemented most of them, and your input is making the game better every day!

🌠 New Feature: Meteors (Thanks to rcjoe69!)

On loaded saves made before 04/14/2025, the first meteor shower will trigger after 20 minutes.


🔧 Fixes & Improvements

The mouse cursor now correctly appears in the bug report box.

Thanks again for being part of the journey—we appreciate you! 💥🛠️

notes.title: Meteor Update April 10 (PF59)
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=IxeP823POqw;full][/previewyoutube]

A big thank you to everyone for your feedback, suggestions, and bug reports! We’ve implemented most of them, and your input continues to shape the game in awesome ways.

- Meteors have been added—huge shoutout to rcjoe69 for the suggestion!

- They’ll fall once every two hours of gameplay.

- Bosses can now be spawned from meteors using special materials—check the list at dungeon entrances for details.

🔧 Fixes & Improvements:

- Fixed a bug causing bases to destroy parts of themselves when removing objects.

- Nighttime is now brighter for better visibility.

Thanks again for playing and helping us improve the game! 💥🛠️

notes.title: Thank You for Your Feedback!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We want to extend a huge [b]thank you[/b] to all of you for your incredible feedback, suggestions, and bug reports! Your support has been instrumental in helping us improve the game. We’re happy to let you know that we've implemented the majority of your suggestions, and we’re confident that these changes will enhance your experience.

Here’s a quick summary of the updates:
[list][*][b]Armor Variety[/b]: Male and female armors are now more visually distinct, giving characters a clearer, unique look.[/*][*][b]Crafting Enhancements[/b]: A [b]search feature[/b] has been added for crafting items, along with a new [b]material indicator[/b] that shows if you have enough resources to craft an item.[/*][*][b]Deadlier Dungeons[/b]: Enemy awareness in dungeons has been adjusted, making them even more challenging. You’ll also find [b]new loot[/b], including a chance for [b]legendary items[/b] in dungeon containers![/*][*][b]New Customization[/b]: Players can now adjust [b]mouse sensitivity[/b] to suit their preferences.[/*][*][b]Achievements & Communication[/b]: [b]Steam Achievements[/b] have been added, and a [b]Ping System[/b] will make team communication smoother.[/*][/list]
These updates should improve both gameplay and customization, offering more immersive and challenging experiences!

[b]Demo Update Coming This Week![/b]

The demo will be [b]updated within the week[/b], and it will include a number of bug fixes and community-requested changes. However, we wanted to give you a heads-up about one known issue related to the terrain loading system:
[list][*]If you have visited a [b]snow biome[/b] in your current save, you may notice some [b]floating meshes and loot boxes[/b] after the update. This is due to a terrain update that affects these specific areas. We’re working on a permanent fix, but we wanted to be transparent about this bug in the meantime.[/*][/list]
[b]Saves Transfer to Full Game[/b]

As a reminder, all of your saves from the demo will seamlessly transfer over to the full game when you purchase it. However, if your save was made in a version [b]before October 2024[/b], the snow biome issue with floating meshes and boxes will persist in the full game.

Thank you again for your continued support, and we can’t wait to hear your thoughts on the updated demo!

Happy gaming!
